policy.binding: Reuse checksum-pinned MHCflurry 2.3.14 affinity predictions and native Vaxrank 3.46.0 contributions; no new model inference.
policy.expression: Positive supplied transformed gene value; affinity contribution sum times its square root. No raw-read abundance or splice-fraction multiplier.
policy.hydropathy: 19-aa Kyte-Doolittle mean strictly greater than 1.6 is excluded.
policy.input_pool: Recorded windows passing native RNA/frame/peptide review, existing HLA-I admission, coordinate-normal ND and limited strand checks.
policy.junction_context_targets: When the same recorded alignment path translated with reference bases is already nonself, normal-DNA changes are reported separately; no somatic-DNA requirement is invented for an RNA junction.
policy.limits: RNA sequence support does not prove protein translation, unique genomic placement, RNA editing, tumour specificity, HLA presentation or immunogenicity. Normal catalog ND is coordinate-specific.
policy.normal_change_dependent_targets: Require resolved reference-supported or present-in-normal calls for peptide-overlapping nonsynonymous differences and at least one reference-supported difference when novelty relies on the RNA changes. A normal-carried background change does not by itself disqualify a separate RNA change. Missing/conflicting or solely normal-carried changes remain in the review tier. These are nominated-locus checks, not proof of unique repeat origin.
policy.ranking: Best eligible window per event, then gene; original event/window tie-break. No top-N quota or automatic construct additions.
policy.reference_scope: All Ensembl 103 translations, UniProt UP000005640 canonical/additional isoforms and recorded bounded patient-normal coding/HLA models.
policy.scope: Screen reconstructed RNA windows before choosing additional splice-source genes; do not change a construct automatically.
